All new endpoints work — feed scope=followers/all, /courses/{name}/rounds, hole_scores/hole_pars roundtrip, /comments with mentions, /users/{id}/achievements (correct earned flags for [82,74,96,79]), auto-seed with mutual follows. minor.issue: Stale iter1 test — assumes no pre-existing follow, but seed now creates mutual follows between demo users so first toggle returns following=False. Update test to register a fresh user and target another fresh user (not seeded).

ui_bugs.issue: After picking a mention suggestion (e.g. tapping mention-suggest-<id>), the component calls inputRef.current?.setNativeProps({ selection: {...} }) inside a setTimeout at src/components/MentionInput.tsx:85. React Native Web's TextInput does NOT expose setNativeProps, so this throws 'inputRef.current?.setNativeProps is not a function' and Expo web renders a full-page red error overlay. The mention text IS inserted correctly ('Great round @Jordan_Kim '), but the overlay blocks subsequent taps — the following comment submit does not fire (post detail shows 0 comments after 'send'). Wrap the setNativeProps call with Platform.OS !== 'web' guard, or drive caret via a controlled `selection` state prop instead.

integration_issues.issue: Comment with mention is not submitted end-to-end on web due to the setNativeProps crash above. Native builds may still work, but web preview is broken.

rca_of_issue: MentionInput.tsx line 85 executes `inputRef.current?.setNativeProps({ selection: { start: nextCaret, end: nextCaret } })` inside a setTimeout after inserting an @Mention. On React Native Web, TextInput's underlying element does not implement setNativeProps, so the optional chaining stops null but the resulting function-call attempt throws 'setNativeProps is not a function'. Reproduction: sign in → open any post detail → focus comment input → type '@' → tap any mention-suggest-<id> → red overlay appears. Mitigation: `if (Platform.OS !== 'web') inputRef.current?.setNativeProps?.({ selection: ... })` OR use `<TextInput selection={selRange} onSelectionChange={...} />` with state so caret is set declaratively.
